limits: Only 144 zero-argument static-table wrappers are owned; all immediate constructors, initializer bodies and registration leaves execute unchanged original instructions.
Full integer source input/output masks are 0x7ff; preserve_mask zero asserts no transitive preservation invariant, while every selected original output is still compared.
Void means the dispatcher ignores a semantic return; original live EAX must survive every CALL and tail and remains a full selected output witness.
Exact JMP sites are elected during case setup with Env.source_tail_edge; the manifest schema has no tail-site field. The packet notes retain all 144 root-tail sites and 22 constructor-tail sites.
Scripted physical imports must model observable memory and ownership effects; a physical stop has no returned tail disposition.
RaiseException never receives fabricated normal success; genuine exception/unwind closure is outside the ordinary wrapper contract and requires separate guest authorization.
GetProcAddress and original indirect callbacks must retain real original code identities when taken; no constructor or initializer body may be replaced by an env.stub.
Direct source inspection is a conservative closure with unresolved dynamic callbacks; it is not connected startup, native constructor closure or app acceptance.
The integer source envelope is not a separately captured x87/SSE state certificate for original descendants.

CRT memory-service v1 supplies malloc/free/capacity/realloc through one live allocation owner; capacity at 0x4a6560 is cdecl1/u32 and realloc at 0x4a9070 is cdecl2/u32, retaining actual caller cleanup and argument words.

Capacity accepts only an exact live allocation base and returns its stored usable capacity, separate from requested size; interior, retired or foreign pointers are unsupported, never synthetic success.

Realloc v1 preserves the old byte prefix on in-place or moved success; failure returns zero with old identity, bytes and capacity intact. Realloc(null,n) delegates to allocation; realloc(live,0) retires and returns zero.

The selected bounded allocation domain uses 16-byte alignment and rounded usable capacity with initial new-mode zero; source new-handler retry or arithmetic outside the declared bounds requires an honest stop.

Memory services never prefill the callback vector, bypass capacity queries, rewrite registry globals, synthesize source lock calls or supply fake small-block/Windows heap metadata. Registration and fatal source paths remain original.

Windows CRT heap internals behind the selected capacity/realloc boundary are excluded from this comparison domain; previously declared conservative import references do not require executing those internals.
CRT memory-service v1 usable capacity is a scripted physical stand-in sharing the malloc/free/realloc owner ledger.
